messages:
Rory (ENG-MGR): Quick Q  targeting a promo for Lina to L4, want comp change and hireband move. Effective date 2026-08-01. What do you need and by when?
Ava (People Ops): To make 8/1 HRIS effective + payroll same month: promo packet + signed comp-change into the payroll folder by the payroll cutoff (two business weeks before pay run).
Rory (ENG-MGR): What goes in the packet to avoid rounds?
Ava (People Ops): Manager rationale (3 bullets), 2 concrete contributions (links + 1-line impact), one peer quote, proposed comp (base/bonus%), PeopleSoft ID, requested effective date, and manager sign-off. If moving bands include suggested band and peer comparators.
Emma (Comp): If proposed base > band max, include comp-exception note and cc comp-approvals. For values between midpoint and max, document market/peer justification.
Sam (Payroll): Include DOB and PeopleSoft ID. Retro pay needs signed comp-change before cutoff; late submissions push pay to next payroll.
Rory (ENG-MGR): Can I tell Lina in a 1:1 before payroll is done?
Ava (People Ops): Private 1:1 okay. Hold off on team announcements or offer emails until People Ops confirms HRIS entry and payroll sync.
Rory (ENG-MGR): Any preferred file name or template?
notify-bot: Promo template: https://redwood.example.com/internal/promo-template. File name: promo_<FIRST>_<LAST>_<MGR>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf
Rory (ENG-MGR): Anything special for band moves across orgs?
Emma (Comp): If the move crosses organizational banding, add 2-3 peer comparators and note any compensation harmonization. Expect extra review time.
Ava (People Ops): Copy/paste checklist:
- Promo template
- Manager rationale (3 bullets)
- 2 contributions (links + 1-line impact)
- Peer feedback excerpt
- Proposed comp (base, bonus %)
- PeopleSoft ID + DOB
- Manager sign-off + transfer approvals if applicable
- Comp-exception note if > band max
Rory (ENG-MGR): Great, i'll drop the packet by Friday for the August payroll cutoff. Thanks all.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks  ping if you want a quick pre-review. notify-bot: Reminder: Do not announce promotions publicly until People Ops confirms payroll sync.
